dedupe_keys.name: qatar census 2010 2015 and 2020 completed residential buildings by municipality and connection to water electricity and drainage networks with housing units by type and municipality qatar open data cc by

description: Qatar's census results are published as small datasets on the national open data portal, which runs on Opendatasoft with an open API. One dataset counts completed residential buildings in each of the eight municipalities by connection to the public water, electricity and drainage networks for the 2010, 2015 and 2020 censuses; related datasets give housing units by type (villas, apartments, Arabic and public houses) and municipality for 2010 and 2020, national shares of buildings connected to each network for 2010 and 2015, buildings by condition, and households by type of housing unit back to 1986. Coverage is national: in 2020 all 165,619 completed residential buildings were connected to water and electricity and 156,790 to drainage, leaving 8,829 not on the sewer network. Format and access: free CSV, JSON and Excel exports and a records API, no registration. Licence: CC BY as stated on the portal. Caveats: municipality level only; the Planning and Statistics Authority website reset the connection from the cloud, so its own census pages were not read. Simulation uses: municipal counts of buildings off the drainage network for wastewater planning, and housing unit mix by municipality for exposure. Related records: the Qatar building permits and completion certificates statistics and the Qatar green spaces statistics.
